_comment: Blocked words (matched after lowercasing, removing separators, collapsing repeated letters and mapping leetspeak and Cyrillic/Latin look-alikes, in both directions). A word starting with ^ matches only at the START of a word or of the whole name (Себастьян, СПИДРАН, Rebate stay allowed); a word starting with = matches only a WHOLE word or the whole name (Huynh, Huizinga, Sukarno, Ebanks stay allowed; real names that ARE the word, e.g. Hui or Huy, are rejected). Extend freely. This data file is the only place where non-English text is allowed.
